description: Abayuda bazanira Yesu umugore yafashwe asambana, kugira ngo yicishwe amabuye hisunzwe icagezwe ca Mose. Maze Yesu arunama yandikisha urutoke hasi yunamutse asanga asigaranye nawa mugore gusa. Kubera Yesu abona ibiri mu mitima, yarabona ko batagomba gutera amabuye uwo mugore ariko ko bashaka kuyatera wenyene  , kwari ukumugeza ngo barabe ingene avyifatamwo.
name: Abafarisayo bahigira Yesu babonye ashishikaye izo nyigisho.

description: Yesu ahanura ubwanyuma kandi yongera yigisha abigishwa biwe imbere yuko afatwa ngo abambwe.
name: Abakunda Yesu bategerezwa kwitondera ivyagezwe vyiwe.

description: Yesu akora igitangaza mu gukiza umuntu yari yavutse ar’impumyi.Abayuda aho gushima ico gitangaza; baciye barushiriza kwanka Yesu.Naho Yesu yari yaje azanye umuco w’isi kandi nawe nyene ubwiwe ari umuco w’isi, benshi bashimye kuguma mu mwiza, bagumana ivyaha vyabo.
name: Babaza uwahora ari impumyi ingene yahumutse.

description: Intangamarara y’igitabo c’ubutumwa bwiza bwanditswe na Yohana kugirango abasoma n’abumva bamenye ko Yesu ari umwana w’ Imana ihoraho.
name: Ibintu bikuru bikuru biranga ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yohana.

description: Yesu ashishikara guhanura abigishwa biwe yongera abaremesha ati: “naho mw’isi muri n’amarushwa ; ni muhumure jewe naranesheje isi”
name: Igikorwa c’ umwitsa

description: Abantu bashinga intahe yuko Yesu ariwe Kristo uwera w’ Imana igihe yakora igitangaza ca mbere mu bugeni i Kana i Gariraya.
name: Igikorwa Yesu yakoze mu bugeni bw’i Kana mu Bugarire.

description: Yesu ashitse i Yelusalemu ahasanga abantu benshi bagwaye baryamye i ruhande y’ikidengeri citwa Betesida maze barizera arabakiza.
name: Igishingira intahe Yesu.

description: Yesu amaze kwigisha ivy’umutsima w’ubugingo benshi baciye batangura kumuheba ariko hariho abemeye kugumana nawe. Yesu yongera kubibutsa ko inyigisho ziwe Atari iziwe ariko ko ari izuwamutumye.Yesu rero yigisha ivyo yatumwe na Data wo mw’ijuru.
name: Ingene abigishwa ba Yesu bakiriye nabi inyigisho zerekeye umutsima w’ubugingo.

description: Ingene Yesu yafashwe igihe yari Getsemane hanyuma bamujana imbere y’umukuru yitwa Anasi; uwo yahora ari umuherezi mukuru kandi yaragifise ijambo mu gikorwa c’ubuherezi kandi ngo yari umunyabwenge cane kandi ko yari umuntu mubi mubaherezi bakuru bose.
name: Ingene bafashe Yesu ngo bamwice.

description: Yohani umubatizi ashingira intahe Yesu Kristo ko ariwe mwagazi w’intama w’Imana ukuraho ivyaha vy’abari mw’isi.
name: Ingene Jambo yigize umuntu.

description: Yesu arangiza guhanura abigishwa biwe yongera abasengera.
name: Isengesho ry’umwami wacu Yesu Kristo

description: Yesu aha inyigisho nyinshi abigishwa biwe hamwe n’ishengero rinini kuvy’umutsima w’ubugingo.
name: Ishengero ribaza Yesu ikimenyetsoyokora kugira rimwizere.

description: Yesu agirana ikiganiro na Nik odemu wa mufarisayo yaza kuri we mw’ijoro .Yesu yaramubwiye amajambo akomeye y’agakiza mu kumwereka ko atanumwe ashobora kubona ubwami bw’Imana atemeye kuvuka ubwa kabiri.
name: Ivy’umufarisayo yitwa Nicodemu akaba n’umukuru wo mu Bayuda.

description: Yesu Kristo niwe Jambo kandi niwe Mana ihoraho.
name: Jambo w’ Imana,Uwamyeho kandi azohoraho

description: Yesu yarisiguye imbere ya Pilato, ariko n’aho ata caha bamusanganye, yarishwe arahambwa azira ivyaha vy’abari mw’isi.
name: Kwisigura kwa Yesu imbere ya Pilato

description: Kubera ko abigishwa ba Yesu batari batahuye igituma yabogeje ibirenge, baramubajije na we abishura ko botahura yuko bazokwama bakeneye guca bugufi imbere y’abo bazobwira ubutumwa bwiza.
name: Kwozwa na Yesu kugira ngo ducudike na we.

description: Simoni petero yihakana Yesu incuro gatatu. Twabonye kandi ingene Yesu yireguye imbere y’umuherezi mukuru n’imbere ya Pilato.
name: Petero yihakana Yesu ubwa mbere.

description: Yesu yarabambwe, arapfa, hanyuma arahambwa ariko yarazutse ku musi ugira gatatu.
name: Uguhambwa n’ukuzuka kwa Yesu

description: Yesu yazukanye umubiri wejejwe utagipfa, yiyereka Mariya kandi yiyereka n’abigishwa biwe.
name: Ukuzuka kwa Yesu ni intsinzi ku bakristo

description: Abafarisayo n’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe baza kugeza yesu bamuzanira umugore ngo yafashwe asambana bamusaba ko uwo mugore yokwicishwa amabuye.Maze Yesu aca abereka ko nabo ari abanyavyaha baca bavaho barahunga.Yesu aca abigisha ababwira ko ariwe muco w’isi kandi ko Abayuda banse kwizera yuko Kristo Yesu  ariwe Mesiya umukiza w’abari mw’isi ko bazopfira mu vyaha kubw’ivyo.
name: Umugore yafashwe asambana

description: Yesu yigisha abayuda abasanze i Yerusaremu. Aho niho yerekanye abana b’ Imana nyakuri ab’ aribo. Abo ni abizera ko Yesu Kristo ari umwana w’ Imana uwaje nk’umukiza w’abari mw’isi bose. Yesu rero ntiyigeze ahuza n’abo bayuda, bahavuye batora amabuye ngo bamwice ariko arayomboka arabasiga.
name: Umuntu amaze kwiha Kristo aba umwana nyakuri.

description: Yesu amaze kuzura Lazaro, abayuda baca baja inama yo kumwica ariko ntibashobora kumufata ngo bamwice kuko igihe ciwe kitari bwagere.
name: Urupfu rwa Lazaro munyuma Yesu aramuzura.

description: Yesu akora igitangaza ahaza abantu ibihumbi bitanu .Yesu yongera gushishikara yigisha ivyerekeye umutsima n’amazi y’ubugingo.
name: Yesu agaburira abantu ibihumbi bitanu, agendesha amaguru ku kiyaga.

description: Igitanza ca mbere Yesu yakoze hamwe n ingene yahumanuye urusengero rw’ i Yerusaremu ubwambere.Umwe mu banyacubahiro yizera Yesu ata buryarya kandi bagenzi we batagomba kumwemera uwo Yesu .uwo naw e ni Nikodemu umufarisayo; umukuru wo mu Bayuda.
name: Yesu ahumanura urusengero ashitse i Yerusaremu.

description: Yesu akiza umuntu yavutse ari impumyi, uwari yavutse atabona kandi yari yarabuze yari yarabuze igitabara.Ingene abantu bakiriye ico gitangaza uhereye ku babanyi buwo yaragiriwe ubuntu.
name: Yesu ahumura uwavutse ar’impumyi.

description: Ivy’ububasha bwa Yesu .Amajambo menshi aratwereka ko Yesu Kristo ar’ Imana ifise ububasha bwo kuzura abapfuye kandi yahawe ububasha bwo kuzocira imanza amahanga.
name: Yesu akiza abantu babiri.

description: Ibishingira intahe ko Yesu Kristo ko ari we Mesiya umwana w’Imana.Uko Yesu akora niko na Se akora.Yesu yahawe ububasha bwo gukiza no guca imanza niyagaruka.Yesu afise ububasha bwose .Yesu niwe Mana.
name: Yesu akiza uwaramaze imyaka myinshi aryamye ku kidengeri.

description: Intsinzi iri mu musalaba wa Yesu Kristo.Umusalaba ufise ububasha bwo gutsinda satani.Umenye kandi utahure ko twaronse intsinzi kubw’umusalaba wa yesu Kristo maze satani nawe akaba uwutsindwa mw’izina rya Yesu Kristo.
name: Yesu apfa k’umusaraba kubw’ivyaha vyacu.

description: Yesu yoza ibirenge vy’intumwa .Dutegerezwa kwozwa kugirango dukundire Imana twitwe abana bayo.
name: Yesu arangiza ibikorwa vyiwe yakoreye ahabona

description: Yesu abonye abigishwa biwe bahagaritse imitima, arabaremesha, atangura kubumvisha ko igikuru ari kumwizera.Arababwira ko bazonezerwa bashitse i muhira kwa Se, kandi ati ni jewe nzira yo kubashikanayo.
name: Yesu aremesha abigishwa biwe.

description: Yesu yongera gusengera ubumwe hagati y’abamwizera; asaba Imana Data ko abarinda wa mubi kandi yongera asabira abigishwa ko Imana ibeza, n’umunezero hamwe nukwuzura mpwemu.
name: Yesu asengera abigishwa n’ishengo

description: Yesu asigwa amavuta ari Betaniya.Yesu ashika I Yerusaremu ari kunyana y’indogoba.Abagiriki bagomba kuraba Yesu baciye kuri Firipo kubera bo bavuga ururimi rw’ ikigiriki kandi Firipo nawe yarafise izina ry’ ikigiriki.
name: Yesu asigwa amavuta ari Betaniya.

description: Yesu amenyeshwa ivy’ingwara ya Lazaro, ariko rero ntiyaca aja kumuraba ubwo nyene.Yesu yageze kuja kumuraba asanga yapfuye mbere amaze kane mu mva.
name: Yesu azura Lazaro w’i Betaniya.

description: Yesu niwe muzabibu w’ukuri, amashami yawo nayo n’abigishwa.Umuzabibu kugira wame imbuto utegerezwa gukorerwa neza. Igihe rero ayo mashami atama barayaca bakayaterera mu muriro kuko ataco aba akimaze.Amashami rero akwiye kuguma ku muzabibu kugirango yame.Niwaba ugomba kuba umukristo mwiza ukwiye kuguma muri Yesu Kristo kugirango wame imbuto zikwiranye n’ukwihana.
name: Yesu n’ umuzabibu, abigishwa nibo mashami yawo.

description: Yesu aremesha abigishwa biwe kuko yagira asubire kwa Se.Yesu yarazi ibizobashikako vyose, arabaremesha mukubabwira ko badakwiye kuzotsitazwa n’ ibizobashikako.
name: Yesu n’umuzabibu, abakristo n’amashami yawo.

description: Yesu kristo na Data Imana ni umwe.Ko hari ubugingo inyuma y’urupfu, abantu dukwiye gutegura tukiriho ingene tuzobaho inyuma y’urupfu.
name: Yesu n’umwungere mwiza kandi mukuru.

description: Simoni Petero yasabwe kuragira intama za Yesu mu gihe Yesu yari ahejeje kumubaza incuro zitatu zose ikibazo kimwe c’uko amukunda.
name: Yesu ni umwami w’imitima yacu n’ukubaho kwacu

description: Yesu n’umwungere mwiza kandi niwe mwungere mukuru.Yesu n’irembo ry’urugo rw’intama, irembo ry’intama.Yesu niwe nzira yacu ducamwo ngo turonke ubugingo.
name: Yesu yaje ari umwungere mwiza.

description: Yesu yiyeretse abigishwa Toma agira ugukekeranya ariko arahava arizezwa n’uko hari ico abonye, hanyuma arasaba imbabazi. Yiyeretse abigishwa ku kiyaga Tiberiya anabakorera igitangaza baroba ifi nyinshi.
name: Yesu yiyereka Toma n’abigishwa ku kiyaga ca Tiberiya

description: Yesu amaze gushingirwa intahe na Yohani umubatizi yahuye n’umugore w’umusamariyakazi baganira kuvy’amazi y’ubugingo.Uwo mugore aca atangura guca bugufi amaze kumenya ko Yesu ari uwuvugishwa n’Imana.Uwo mugore yagerageje kwerekana ko yarasanzwe azi ivy’idini rya basekuruza.
name: Yohani umubatizi yongera gushingira intahe Yesu.
